svg.title: Add-one smoothing gives unseen events probability
svg.desc: For context “has”, maximum likelihood assigns zero to unseen “rains”. Add-one adds one pseudo-count to each of the nine vocabulary choices, making the denominator 2+9=11: begun and arrived each get 2/11, while rains gets 1/11.

g.text: Add-one smoothing gives unseen events probability
A zero count means “unseen,” not “impossible”; pseudo-counts redistribute mass.
The unseen pair gets exactly zero.
Every other vocabulary item also gets 1/11;
the full row still sums to 1.
